t: This is the Roman Catholic church of Our Lady of Mount Carmel and St Simon Stock, at 41 Kensington Church Street. It is served by Discalced Carmelites, a Catholic religious order. The church was designed by Giles Gilbert Scott, the architect who also gave London Battersea Power Station and the red telephone box, and who designed Liverpool Cathedral. It sits on a busy Kensington street, so step inside if the door is open and you want a quieter few minutes.
